external_source.paper: Runaway is Ashamed, But Helpful: On the Early-Exit Behavior of Large Language Model-based Agents in Embodied Environments

observed_mechanism.intrinsic_exit: Prompt-level instruction asks the acting model to emit EXIT when it believes the task/environment is complete or further progress is unlikely.
observed_mechanism.extrinsic_exit: A verifier LLM periodically reads task/goal/history and emits free-form text; any response containing the substring YES sets an exit_flag.
observed_mechanism.coupling: The combined agent does not directly halt on verifier YES. On the next run it enables the intrinsic exit prompt, asking the acting model to emit EXIT.
observed_mechanism.verifier_independence: The same llm_model object is used for acting and verification in the inspected implementation.
observed_mechanism.measurement_concept: The project/paper separates saved redundant steps from progress degradation rather than treating early exit as an unqualified success.
observed_mechanism.continuation_concept: The paper/repository reports a stronger-agent continuation after early exit as a bounded recovery/escalation strategy.

static_negative_findings.finding: Verifier parsing is not structured: `if "YES" in response` accepts any free-form response containing YES, so negated/quoted/incidental YES can statically satisfy the stop condition.
The combined agent defines INTRINSIC_PROMPT key `short_thought` but the non-exit branch indexes `thought_short`. This is a static key mismatch on an ordinary prompt-construction path.

`intrinsic_using_flag` is initialized in reset only when extrinsic_exit is enabled, while run/make_prompt references it for non-None intrinsic_exit. The default intrinsic configuration therefore has a source-visible initialization hazard unless another unobserved path sets it.

The verifier collapses qualitatively different reasons—stuck loop, task complete, infeasible/deviated—into the same YES bit. That is incompatible with F2 authority boundaries if copied literally because HOLD/ASK/DELEGATE and COMPLETE must remain distinct.

Repository hygiene is research-grade rather than product-grade at the pin: the tree includes an `.env` path and committed `__pycache__` artifacts. No secret value was consumed or promoted by this audit.

f2_hypothesis.statement: AgentExit should be distilled as a measurement/control pattern, not imported as a controller. A low-cost F2 WP509 stop controller can use deterministic repetition/progress/resource signals to create a typed StopCandidate, with any semantic verifier only advisory. The candidate should route to HOLD/ASK/DELEGATE/REOBSERVE; canonical COMPLETE remains separately evidenced and gated.
why: The external mechanism directly targets repetitive/no-progress loops.
The paired redundancy-vs-progress-loss framing matches F2's need to avoid trading quality for fewer steps.
The inspected implementation's free-form verifier and control conflation are too weak for direct authority adoption.
Deterministic first-line signals are cheaper and avoid an extra provider/model call under current FREE_ONLY/provider-unadmitted authority.

counterhypothesis.statement: WP509 may not need a semantic verifier at all: deterministic loop signatures, state-fingerprint repetition, prediction residuals, progress deltas and resource budgets may detect most harmful rumination more reliably and cheaply than a model-based stop judge.
counterhypothesis.discriminator: On replayable F2 traces, compare deterministic-only vs deterministic+advisory-semantic StopCandidate generation for redundant-step reduction, false early stops, progress degradation, latency/tokens and reason-calibration.

proposed_f2_distillation.completion_rule: StopCandidate MUST NOT mint COMPLETE, task success, effect success or world truth.
proposed_f2_distillation.resource_policy: Use deterministic local signals first; semantic verifier only for unresolved cases and only on an admitted zero-cost route.

next_evidence_objective.recommendation: Map the distilled typed StopCandidate contract to current WP509/WP505/WP800 interfaces; do not import AgentExit execution code.
